items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk3NzM1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--452320b66befe4473e64714d2b10c5758fa03f1f/BR%20(2).png) Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: ​ - **Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado.** Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuboemEtapasVilaVelha2026/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ​ ------------------------------------- ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk3NzM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7cc91f261678c6cb3253be36e27fef7f8f3b2c35/UK%20(2).png) We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: ​ - **Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent.** For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IICuboemEtapasVilaVelha2026/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8&pp=ygUhSG93IHRvIGNvbXBldGUgaW4gd2NhIGNvbXBldGl0aW9u); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience! ​ ------------------------------------- #### Organização/Organization: ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1JMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21d308c05a84a509a0a5091b9aae85d06e9b68c7/speedcubes-logo-0.25x.png)

items.name: Don't DNF Dallas 2026
items.information: ##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features mainly blindfolded events. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list), including [DFW Cubing Fall 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingFall2026) taking place in Arlington the day before.** This event is not sponsored by the Dallas Public Library. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI4MDMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2cde4839fc69270c03198a1ceca1b5caef35729f/1000018149.png) **This is the FMC-only part of [GAN WCA Oceanic Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OC2026)**. As FMC will not be held at the main competition, this is your chance to compete for the 2026 Oceanic FMC Champion title. Podium finishers will be recognised during the main awards ceremony in Auckland, if they are present. The competition will be held in multiple locations, across New Zealand and Australia. Please pay attention to the **schedule and time zone** of your location.

items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu Hanoi ChessNCube 2026! Giải đấu này được tổ chức bỏi câu lạc bộ C3-CSP Cubing Club và Hội Bàn Cờ. **Giải đấu này sẽ được tổ chức song song cùng với một giải đấu cờ vua! Vui lòng xem thêm thông tin tại tab tương ứng.** ***Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh*** *BTC sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu; khi có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, bạn đồng thời công nhận toàn quyền vĩnh viễn cho phép BTC và các đối tác/nhà tài trợ sử dụng tư liệu này cho các hoạt động trong tương lai. Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.* _____________________________________________ Welcome to Hanoi ChessNCube 2026! This competition will be organized by C3-CSP Cubing Club and Hội Bàn Cờ (The Chess Table). **A chess tournament will be held concurrently with this competition! Please check the corresponding tab for more information.** ***Notice on photography and filming*** *The organization team will perform filming and photography at the competition; by being present at the venue, you grant the organization team and its partners/sponsors full perpentual rights to use such material for future activities. If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIxMDM5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ded7548044d0ec26d7eb3c2b7963c971c73ce15a/vietnamcube%20(1).png)
